overview: You read four boxes on the plot. Gaunt is carried. The king leaves Flint a king and comes on in a London street. The Queen is in the garden. You did not take the rest of the board for a speech.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Read the four boxes, and did not unpeg the board.

parties.name: Abel Garnish
parties.context: The hand is his. He was not beside the peg for this.
